acquisition_method.evidence: The samples were analyzed in Data Independent Acquisition (DIA) mode.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: followed by the addition of 50 μl of 50 mM Iodioacetamide (IAA) and centrifugation at 6,000 × g for 20 min at room temperature.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: followed by the addition of 50 μl of 50 mM Iodioacetamide (IAA) and centrifugation at 6,000 × g for 20 min at room temperature.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Enzymatic digestion was then performed overnight at 37°C by adding 500 ng of proteomics grade trypsin (MilliporeSigma) in 60 μl of 50 mM TEAB buffer at pH 8.5.

collision_energy.evidence: Full MS scans were performed in the range from 350 m/z up to 1,000 m/z with 60000 of resolution (AGC target Custom; maximum injection time 50 and collision energy 25).

fractionation_method.evidence: Then, 40 μl (corresponding to 10 μg of digested peptides) of each extract were purified by StageTip SCX as described by Rappsilber et al, to remove detergent residues.

instrument.evidence: For peptide separation, the present study employed an easy nlC-1000 chromatographic instrument coupled to an Exploris 480 mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific, Inc.).

reduction_concentration.evidence: According to the digestion protocol, 50 μg of cell lysate was mixed with 10% SDS, 500 mM DTT, 1 M Tris HCl, pH 8.0 and incubated at 650 rpm for 10 min at 95°C.
